title: The Hidden Arsenal
text:
*The harbor warehouses hold enough weapons to arm a small army — and that's exactly what Harren intends to do. You gather what allies you have and approach under cover of darkness.*

*The warehouse is guarded by four of Harren's men — mercenaries with the bored alertness of professionals. Inside, crate upon crate of swords, crossbows, and barrels of blasting powder line the walls.*

*Your plan needs to account for the guards, the weapons, and the barrels of blasting powder that could level half the harbor district if mishandled.*

choices.text: Create a distraction and slip inside to destroy the weapons
Lead a direct assault on the warehouse guards
Use your knowledge of the harbor to flood the warehouse
